tagline: A clean, offline text editor with tabs, line numbers, find & replace with live match count, and full encoding/line-ending control.
description: Edit text the way the best editors do, without the clutter. Plain Text Editor 1.1 adopts the layout of Notepad++ while staying simple: every file opens in its own tab (with its own undo history), a line-number gutter and current-line highlight keep you oriented, and a Recent-files sidebar re-opens anything in one click. Find & replace shows a live match count with match-case and whole-word options; the everyday line tools are all here — duplicate, delete and move lines, trim trailing whitespace, go to line, and the F5 time/date stamp. Your file's encoding (UTF-8, UTF-8 BOM, UTF-16, ANSI) and line endings (CRLF/LF) are detected on open, shown in the status bar, preserved exactly on save — and convertible from the Format menu when you choose. A Ctrl+P quick switcher jumps between open tabs and recent files; Ctrl+, opens Settings (System/Light/Dark theme, font size, editor defaults). Follows the system Aura Dark/Light theme live. Fully offline — nothing is ever uploaded.
